tha-ap470:1.1: Pilakkhuphaladāyaka.] Vanante Buddhaṃ disvāna Atthadassiṃ mahāyasaṃ / pasannacitto sumano pilakkhussa phalaṃ adaṃ. // //
tha-ap470:2.1: Aṭṭhārase kappasate yaṃ phalam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap470:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Pilakkhuphaladāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
